name: council
description: MCP server running structured, bounded critique rounds between Claude Code and Codex

scripts.install-skills: mkdir -p "$HOME/.claude/skills/council" "$HOME/.codex/skills/council" && cp skills/claude/SKILL.md "$HOME/.claude/skills/council/SKILL.md" && cp skills/codex/SKILL.md "$HOME/.codex/skills/council/SKILL.md" && echo 'skills installed to ~/.claude and ~/.codex'
